crossRefs.note: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

translations.web: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
translations.bsb: Night pierces my bones, and my gnawing pains never rest.
translations.kjv: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
translations.asv: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, And the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
